0001193125-26-442717.name: Tech Deal Files
0001193125-26-442717.text: @MarvellTech @Lumentum The clause I’d watch: Marvell could owe Lumentum $3.2B if the deal ends under certain regulatory conditions. The $115B headline tells you the deal’s size. The breakup fee tells you who takes the risk if approvals fall through.
0001193125-26-442717.note: Deal detail bankers watch: ~$3.2B regulatory breakup fee owed by Marvell

0001193125-26-442717.name: The Fox
0001193125-26-442717.text: @CKCapitalxx This is crazy, and the arb math makes it even crazier. The deal is fixed at 4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share. At $137.59 for Marvell, that's $619 of stock for every Lumentum share, yet Lumentum trades at $526. That's an 18% spread on a signed deal. Part of it is real deal https://t.co/Bn0CCv9Jie
0001193125-26-442717.note: Merger-arb math: fixed 4.5 MRVL shares per LITE share leaves a wide spread

0001193125-26-442717.name: Yield Cove
0001193125-26-442717.text:
Lumentum $LITE fell 35.9% from Fri Oct 30 to Fri Nov 6. Worst on Eddie's watchlist.

Marvell $MRVL agreed Nov 2 to buy it with its own shares. Marvell fell 28.1%.

So Lumentum now swings with Marvell's price.

Knew a deal could do that?

Free calculator: https://t.co/K7x6wcQzZc https://t.co/UmPTIwxYAP
0001193125-26-442717.note: Since the all-stock deal, LITE trades as a function of MRVL's price
